sideEffects: Private configuration, operation records and screenshots
Account selection; explicit selections remain active, queries restore the original account
Explicit simulated-account batch submission (one Windows worker, up to ten distinct securities)
limitations: Client display freshness, not broker-server verification
Holdings require Codex image review; clipped rows cannot be accepted as complete
Equal fund displays can prevent automatic account switching
Order submission is limited to identified simulated accounts; no real-order submission or cancellation
Unknown submission outcome must not be retried automatically
